what_this_is: The founder's launch participation record for the composed PetTripFinder production bundle. Read by scripts/pettripfinder/launch_participation.py at assembly time. Every registered market must carry a row; only FOUNDER_AUTHORIZED_FOR_LAUNCH admits a market into the composed bundle. This record never states a market's facts: source readiness is derived by the assembler from the market's own census, partition, policy authority and release contract, and a status that disagrees with the source fails the build. Withdrawing a market here changes no byte of that market's authority and does not affect its own per-market assembly.

decision.reason: Founder authorizes Lexington to participate in the next production assembly, joining as the TWELFTH market with 20 pet-friendly profiles over a 57-identity registered census. Every other market's decision is unchanged: detroit-ann-arbor-mi remains NOT authorized even though it is assemblable at 121 published, and nashville-tn, chattanooga-tn and fort-wayne-in are not registered markets and are admitted by no lever here. This decision follows a HALT. PTF-LEXINGTON-KY-FOUNDER-AUTHORIZATION-AND-LIVE-LAUNCH-004 was correctly stopped because the sealed package digest it named could not be reproduced from the committed tree; PTF-LEXINGTON-KY-FRESH-PACKAGE-REAUTHORIZATION-PREP-005 sealed a reproducible package, committed it under the market, and re-proved the candidate. The founder was shown the FRESH digests and bound this decision to them: package sha256:a29e4a966e1b68b918c1b0f34db21ff5525691fc5e7581fb58190cc1031310b0 and candidate 67fe8617b79febb9b2248895441c31ac65931cf9fdcfa4da4f8014ee190cde78 at 12 markets / 823 profiles / 991 routes. The fifteen rows the modern gates hold -- three on the registered identity contract, one on a cross-market identity collision Cleveland already owns, five on the first-party evidence gate and six on missing paid-attempt provenance -- are NOT resolved by this decision and no held row is promoted.

lineage.what_this_is: Every participation record this one descends from, oldest first, so a deployment authorization can still be matched to the record it signed after more than one reissue. supersedes names only the immediate predecessor; with four reissues behind it that is no longer enough to walk the chain.

decision.decision_basis: Founder work order PTF-LEXINGTON-KY-FRESH-FOUNDER-AUTHORIZATION-AND-LIVE-LAUNCH-006: "I explicitly AUTHORIZE the CURRENT FRESH REPRODUCIBLE Lexington candidate produced by PTF-LEXINGTON-KY-FRESH-PACKAGE-REAUTHORIZATION-PREP-005", directing that every digest be read mechanically from the CURRENT committed fresh packet and that no digest from an older Lexington authorization packet be used, and approving the participation transition SOURCE_READY_BUT_NOT_FOUNDER_AUTHORIZED_FOR_LAUNCH -> FOUNDER_AUTHORIZED_FOR_LAUNCH for lexington-ky alone.
